### `Force`

Forces (spec 19 §19.5).

One of:

- object {`at`, `targets`, `vector`, `spin`, `mode`, `spread`, `stagger`, `type`}: Impulse (P2).
- object {`at`, `center`, `strength`, `radius`, `falloff`, `spin`, `mode`, `targets`, `type`}: Explosion (P2).
- object {`vector`, `turbulence`, `targets`, `from`, `to`, `ramp`, `mode`, `type`}: Wind field (constant `vector` P2; `turbulence` P3).
- object {`center`, `strength`, `radius`, `falloff`, `targets`, `from`, `to`, `ramp`, `mode`, `type`}: Attractor field (P3).
- object {`center`, `strength`, `pull`, `radius`, `falloff`, `targets`, `from`, `to`, `ramp`, `mode`, `type`}: Vortex field (P3).
- object {`amount`, `targets`, `from`, `to`, `ramp`, `type`}: Drag field (P3).
